create.name: Alexandra Kreis
create.bio:
Alexandra Kreis is a Berlin-based teacher of Hatha yoga, meditation and devotional chanting, and she shares her work with her partner Richard Fuhrmann under the name Being Alive Now. Her own grounding is in Hatha yoga, which she has practised for many years alongside Qi Gong, Tai Chi and a study of Ayurveda, and over time kirtan, the call-and-response singing of mantras and the names of Hindu deities, became the heart of what she offers. Richard, who trained in a range of consciousness and energy-awareness methods, brings energy work and music to their shared programmes.

Together they lead small residential retreats that weave chanting, gentle movement, energy work and group reflection. Their autumn Mallorca intensive centres on singing the Hanuman Chalisa 108 times with live instruments, each round dedicated to an intention, an approach inspired by the kirtan of Krishna Das and his teacher Neem Karoli Baba. Their year-long online group, Destiny Fulfilled, meets twice a month for sharing, mantras and a guided energy meditation, framed around five areas of life. Alexandra's short guided meditations, breath practices and mantra recordings are free on Insight Timer, and the pair also release devotional music together.

courses.title: Mallorca Mantra Intensive 2027
courses.description: An eight-day residential retreat in a villa on Mallorca for up to fifteen people, built around chanting the Hanuman Chalisa 108 times with live music. Each chanting session begins with a personal intention, and the days include gentle yoga, energy work and question-and-answer time.
courses.price: Retreat fee €1,600 EUR if paid before 31 Dec 2026 (€1,800 EUR after), plus lodging from €915 EUR per person (double room) or €1,100 EUR (single room)

courses.title: Destiny Fulfilled (2027 group)
courses.description: A year-long online group for up to twelve people, meeting on Tuesday evenings twice a month. Sessions combine open sharing, mantras and spiritual songs, and a guided energy meditation, with the aim of seeing more clearly where one feels stuck across five areas of life.

free_resources.title: 12-Minute Meditation For Self-Trust & Inner Confidence
free_resources.description: A short guided sit for settling the mind and resting in a sense of trust in oneself. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Full Breath Meditation Feeling At Home In Your Body
free_resources.description: A seven-minute practice of slow, full breathing to bring attention back into the body. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Vulnerability Guided Meditation
free_resources.description: An eleven-minute reflection that invites a gentler, more open relationship with one's own tender places. Free on Insight Timer.
